title: data/sources.json
description: Every source the pipeline knows, with its health in this build and what SOURCES.md lets the site publish.

last_success.description: The date of the newest good snapshot, or null when there is none.

record_count.description: Records the source contributed to this build, published or not.

stale.description: True when this build's fetch failed and the last good snapshot was used, or when there is no snapshot at all.

licence.description: The source's licence in short form as SOURCES.md records it, such as CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, or a short statement such as All rights reserved when the source names no licence.

licence_url.description: The licence text, or the terms page SOURCES.md read when the source has no standard licence.

attribution.description: The attribution text SOURCES.md gives for the source, character for character, on one line. The About page and data/NOTICE.md show it wherever the source is credited.

publish.description: What SOURCES.md allows. full: facts are published. derived-only: only derived facts. evidence-only: used to merge actors and never shown. link-only: metadata and links only.

label.description: Non-empty text with no leading or trailing whitespace and no line breaks.

nullableDate.description: A date, or null when none is known.

sourceKey.description: A connector key such as attack or misp, as listed in sources.json. Never a display name.
